author: Turkey Tom
description:
Bryan Johnson is a multimillionaire who is trying to find the cure to death by 2039. When it was first revealed that he was spending 2 million dollars a year to become immortal, the internet immediately began predicting all the ways he would die. He went viral through podcasts like Theo Von, Chris Williamson, Logan Paul's Impaulsive, Diary of a CEO, and Jubilee, through which he managed to grow his own brand. But now it seems that the reality his critics predicted has finally come to fruition - In June of 2026, Bryan announced that he was diagnosed with Autoimmune Gastritis, a chronic disease that is causing his own stomach to digest itself.  Worst of all, there is no known cure for this disease, so many suspect that his journey for immortality has come to an end.
